services.name: Banana Boat
services.desc: Person: $33 About The banana boat holds 12 people max! The booking minimum is 4 people. If it is only giving you the option to book 1 person, that means that this is all that we have available at that time. Banana boating is a fun and exciting option for the whole family! You board one of our coast guard certified parasail boats and enjoy a ride out to the ocean. Once out there, our mate will assist each person onto the banana and we will pull you behind the boat from 1st street to 31st street and back. The duration of the ride depends on sea conditions and how fast or slow you want to 4 PERSON BOOKING MINIMUM!!

quotes.author: Gina T. on Facebook
quotes.text: We had an AMAZING experience with these guys! In addition to the two adorable pups, they are an incredibly kind family business and provided a great time for us with the jet skis. After an awful experience in Clearwater beach Florida, we were hoping to find a jet ski rental in Virginia that would be fun, let us roam free, and have good customer service attitudes. Rudee inlet jet ski rentals was all of that and more, they even gave us our $10 picture for free. 10/10 and we will be back again.

quotes.author: Tawana S. on Facebook
quotes.text: This was my first time riding the banana boat and it was awesome! From registration to the boat, each and every one of the people working was friendly, kind and knowledgeable! I like to have a good time! And they made the experience wonderful! Hold on tight!! Oh, wear water shoes!

quotes.author: denihan428
quotes.text: Booking jetskis online was so easy! And free parking!! They fit you into life vests and give you a 5 minute safety speech, which was very clear and explained very well. They took us all into open water and we had a ball! What fun! I LOVE how safe these guys are!

quotes.author: Carla D. on Google
quotes.text: These guys were AWESOME! And I don't say that often when I do reviews in general. Great service, great atmosphere, very personable, and they made the ride was super fun! If you want to parasail, choose Adventure Parasail!

quotes.author: Ali D. on Google
quotes.text: They went above and beyond to make sure we had a great time. We will definitely be going back and highly recommend Adventure Parasail.
